author: Russell Brand
description:
Are most Christians actually living according to Jesus Christ's teachings? Russell Brand and his guest challenge the difference between genuine faith and cultural Christianity, discussing the claim that many churchgoers lack a truly Christian worldview. From Jesus' warning, “I never knew you,” to the faith of Abraham and the importance of the Holy Spirit, they explore why following Christ means more than attending church, accepting religious labels, or submitting to institutional authority.
